$comment: Reviewed exceptions to the copy lint. Each entry allows the listed terms in ONE exact string in ONE file, and nothing else. If the string changes, the exception stops matching and the lint fails. So does an exception that no longer matches anything, which stops this list going stale. Adding an entry is a review decision: say why in `reason`, and name the ticket or PR where it was approved in `approved_in`.

exceptions.reason: This is the wellness-not-medical disclaimer itself. The word is there to deny the claim, which is the one legitimate use the ticket names.

exceptions.text: It isn’t a medical device and doesn’t diagnose, treat or monitor illness. It’s wellness guidance. In an emergency call your local emergency number — 999 in the UK, 911 in the US.
exceptions.reason: A1's statement of what Weyos is not, verbatim from the design pack. It names the claims in order to deny them. To be re-derived from the approved intended-purpose statement (SCRUM-121).
